meta.name: Bisaat Khel Shatranj Ka Hindi
meta.description:
Bisaat is a mystery thriller, that revolves around a psychiatrist, Kiyana Verma, who has a habit of getting involved in her patient's life. Kiyana Verma is a young, beautiful woman, who runs a flourishing psychiatric practice in Mumbai, she is married to a talented doctor Abhijit. Kiyana’s biggest problem is that she gets overly emotional about her patients and tries to help them out in her own way which creates more problems in an already cold marriage. Abhijit and Kiyana are perfectly playing the part of an ideal couple but without warmth and love because of a bitter past. Kiyana’s habit of over-involvement in her patient’s life creates more tension in her personal life.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A renowned industrialist Yash Kapoor is dead in the presence of Psychiatrist Kiyana Verma, she runs from the crime scene and goes to her best friend Saba Salim to confide in her. A man is keeping an eye on Kiyana’s every movement.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The episode starts with a cold opening of Anaya’s (Kiyana’s friend) suicide in the past 3 years back which turns out to be the main reason why Kiyana goes overboard to help her patients. Kiyana needs to know if Radhika is telling the truth about Yash or she is suffering from some serious mental disorder.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Abhijit is unaware of Kiyana’s involvement with Yash but he can sense that something is bothering Kiyana and he feels more disconnected which leads him to share his time and emotions with Alisha. With last night’s kiss and Yash’s persona; Kiyana is totally confused, she is not able to decide who is telling the truth; Radhika or Yash.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Kiyana is in a huge trouble, she confesses her involvement with Yash to Saba; who is also a lawyer. Saba tells her to act normal and continue her job. But Kiyana is shaken to her core when she gets to know that Radhika Kapoor is someone else and not the girl who came to her clinic posing as Yash Kapoor’s wife and when she tries to contact fake Radhika, she is unable to.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A layer unfolds and we get to know that the man behind this masterplan is Rajiv Bhatia; a filmmaker who was heavily in debt with Yash Kapoor and wanted to get rid of him so he blackmailed Samaira and forced her to play Radhika and become a patient of Kiyana so in the end she can be framed for the murder.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Saba’s plan succeeds and she gets the bail for Kiyana. Abhijit is not there for Kiyana when she comes out of the prison, it breaks her heart and she feels guilty for hiding things from him and letting him down. Samaira gains consciousness and spills the beans about Rajiv Bhatia.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Kiyana and Abhijit are closer than ever. The husband is standing beside her wife in her worst of times. But Kiyana’s life gets in more trouble when Shreeram finds some proofs pointing at Kiyana’s involvement in Rajiv’s murder.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Abhijit helps Kiyana with Alisha’s confession but she kidnaps him pointing a gun on his head and tells Kiyana to surrender else she will kill Abhijit. The police are on the hunt for Kiyana who is hiding with Samaira.
